data.title: README rewrite: value prop + DevRel best practices

data.body: VALIDATION EVIDENCE: make build clean; every README-shown command executed against the built binary (query all filters, index build/update/show/drop, archive --dry-run, doctor healthy exit 0 + --json, enable, info, install-hooks); session.json + query excerpts generated from a real simulated Claude Code session per docs/HOOK_CONTRACT.md (ref 01KTYTCRTX2D64T59S0G49C2V5 in a temp repo); go install @latest re-verified live; README rendered in c11 markdown surface and proofread; PR https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/etch/pull/7 — merge gated on CI green.

CODE REVIEW (independent adversarial reviewer; lattice auto-review couldn't resolve the worktree diff): verdict FAIL→fixed→PASS. 1 MAJOR: --has-files 'src/**' example implied globstar the matcher lacks (path.Match) — fixed to '*.go', verified matching. 3 MINOR addressed: excerpt labeled as demo-session capture; agent.version dropped from abridged excerpt (code/spec divergence filed as ETCH-50); crash recovery wording precision ('next session start'). Reviewer verified all query flags, info/enable/doctor output shapes, privacy claims (salted hostname, two-ref local_only_fields, refspec scope, HEAD push entry), settings keys, Makefile targets, badges, links, anchors against source + live binary runs. Fixes in cc3e819.

README.md fully rewritten outside-in per the ETCH-49 plan. Landed: hero with one-sentence value prop (flight recorder for AI agent fleets — permanent queryable records in plain git, zero-contention at 60–80+ concurrent agents), target-user why-paragraph, show-don't-tell section with real binary output (query table + abridged session.json from a live demo session per HOOK_CONTRACT.md), <5-min quickstart leading with operator-mode enable, enablement-modes comparison table, loud privacy-posture section (records contain prompt text; local-only by default on public repos; two-ref local_only_fields semantics), honest 'What Etch is not' section positioning vs Entire Checkpoints (fleet scale, complementary layers — kept generous per plan-review note), earned badges only (CI/Apache-2.0/Go). Every shown command verified against the built binary; go install @latest re-verified live; GitHub GFM rendering + anchors + all relative links verified via the markdown API. Plan review PASS (4 minors, all addressed). Independent adversarial code review (lattice auto-review couldn't resolve the worktree diff): 1 MAJOR fixed (--has-files globstar example), 3 minors fixed; spec/code divergence on agent.version filed as ETCH-50. PR https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/etch/pull/7 squash-merged to main (411fcbe), CI green on both commits, remote+local branch and worktree cleaned up. Remains: ETCH-50 (separate ticket).
